subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Deterioration
solution: The correct answer is **"Retrogression."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Deterioration"** means the process of becoming progressively worse. (स्थिति में गिरावट, पतन, ह्रास) • **Example**:* We've seen a **deterioration**__ in relations between the countries.* • **"Retrogression"** means the act of going backwards or declining. (पीछे की ओर जाने या घटने की क्रिया या भाव) __ • **Example**:* The retrogression of the economy has led to job losses and lower wages.* • It is a synonym for **deterioration**. • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Option 2 (Demonstration)** means a public display or protest. (एक सार्वजनिक प्रदर्शन या विरोध) • **Option 3 (Malfunction)** means a failure or breakdown of a machine or system. (इस तरह की ख़राबी) • **Option 4 (Ramification)** means a consequence or result of an action. ((किसी निर्णय या कार्य के) जटिल अनपेक्षित परिणाम) 3d:T649, The correct answer is **"B, A, C, D."**
